title: Network & Routing Configuration
summary: Manages the home Wi-Fi access point, the isolated guest network, the router LAN IP, multi-WAN balancing, live speed monitoring and DNS mode.

items.title: Wi-Fi Access Point (Home WiFi)
items.description: Configures the 2.4/5 GHz access points: SSID naming, WPA2 password and radio state.
items.usage_tip: Use this if clients lose connection to the main Wi-Fi.

items.title: Guest Network & Bandwidth Control (QoS / SQM)
items.description: Opens the guest sub-menu: isolated guest network, guest Wi-Fi SSID and QoS speed limits.
items.usage_tip: Guests stay separated from your LAN and cannot reach your devices.

items.title: Change Local Router LAN IP
items.description: Moves the router to a new subnet (for example 192.168.10.1) and re-sizes the DHCP pool to .100-.249.
items.usage_tip: Use it when your ISP modem already uses 192.168.1.1. Your SSH session will drop after applying.

items.title: Multi-WAN Load Balancer (mwan3)
items.description: Adds USB tethering and Wi-Fi hotspot WAN next to the wired WAN and configures mwan3 with priority failover.
items.usage_tip: Install the mwan3 package yourself before applying load balancing.

items.title: Network Info & Speed Monitor
items.description: Shows public IP, country, ISP/ASN details and offers a real-time download/upload monitor.
items.usage_tip: The speed monitor runs until you press Ctrl+C.

items.title: DNS Manager (DNS modes)
items.description: Chooses how the router resolves DNS: system default, secure DoT/DoH, tunnel or hybrid.
items.usage_tip: Hybrid is the safest pick when you use Passwall.

items.title: Back to Main Menu
items.description: Returns to the main DayPass menu.

items.title: Quit DayPass
items.description: Ends the DayPass session from any menu.
items.usage_tip: Ctrl+C does the same and restores the terminal.

items.title: Help
items.description: Opens the manual of the current screen.
items.usage_tip: Enter or 0 inside a manual returns to the screen you came from; q quits DayPass.
